{{Top|canon=ASP-19 Battle Droid}}
{{Quote|The destruction of hundreds of combat droids per month during training session will be no great loss; the ASP models are poor conversationalists and they bore me.|2-1B, on the training droids of Darth Vader|<ref name="Darth Vader: A 3-D">''[[Star Wars: Darth Vader: A 3-D Reconstruction Log]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Trainingdroid.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] cutting down a training droid in the [[Jedi Praxeum]] training grounds.]]
'''ASP-19 battle droids''' were combat-capable labor droids employed in melee training.

==Characteristics==
Although [[ASP-series labor droid/Legends|ASP-series labor droids]] were simple-minded automata of general-purpose, the ASP-19 variant was capable of wielding melee weapons and was intended to function as a [[Training droid/Legends|training droid]] against organic beings.

==History==
[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] used several droids of this [[ASP-19, Lightsaber Training Configuration, Mark IX|type]], equipped with [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]] to hone his [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber dueling]] skills. Vader's ability to handle this weapon was, in fact, much better than ASP's, so they were less than a match for the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] as he ordered them to be sent to his training grounds in larger numbers. A few ASP-19 were also kept in [[Bast Castle]]'s training chambers on [[Vjun/Legends|Vjun]].

[[File:Aspsaber.jpg|thumb|right|250px|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] practicing with an ASP droid.]]
Later, the [[Jedi Praxeum]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] also used such droids for lightsaber combat practices. They wielded [[Training lightsaber/Legends|training lightsabers]], and could be set at different levels of difficulty. [[Jaden Korr]], when he was apprenticed under [[Kyle Katarn]], was forced to fight one when Katarn's other apprentice, [[Rosh Penin]], set it out in hopes of slowing Jaden down in a training course. Luckily, it was not operating at a high level, so Korr managed to defeat it. He later encountered Vader's leftover ASP-19 droids on a [[Mission to Vjun (Disciples of Ragnos crisis)|mission]] at Vader's castle on Vjun and they were more difficult to defeat (as Vader had them probably set at [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] level for his own practices).<ref name="Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Jedi Academy">''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Jedi Academy]]''</ref>
